title: Mastery of all tense forms and aspects - Perfect command of temporal system

options.answer: By next month, I will have been working here for exactly five years.
By next month, I will have worked here for exactly five years.
By next month, I will be working here for exactly five years.

explanation.en: Future perfect is used for actions completed before a specific future time. Future perfect continuous emphasizes duration continuing up to that point.
explanation.ru: Будущее совершенное время используется для действий, завершенных до определенного момента в будущем. Будущее совершенное длительное подчеркивает продолжительность до этого момента.
explanation.uz: Future perfect ma'lum bir kelajak vaqtdan oldin tugallangan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi. Future perfect continuous o'sha paytgacha davom etgan davomiylikni ta'kidlaydi.

options.answer: Had I known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had knew about the meeting, I would have attended it.
Had I knew about the meeting, I would attended it.

explanation.en: In third conditional inversion, 'had' is followed by the past participle 'known', not the past form 'knew'.
explanation.ru: В инверсии третьего условного предложения после 'had' используется причастие прошедшего времени 'known', а не форма прошедшего времени 'knew'.
explanation.uz: Uchinchi shartli gapning inversiyasida 'had' dan keyin 'known' o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi ishlatiladi, 'knew' o'tgan zamon shakli emas.

options.answer: She has been living in Paris since she was graduated from university.
She has been living in Paris since she graduated from university.
She has been living in Paris since she has graduated from university.

explanation.en: After 'since' with a specific past event, we use simple past tense, not present perfect or passive voice.
explanation.ru: После 'since' с конкретным прошедшим событием используется простое прошедшее время, а не настоящее совершенное или страдательный залог.
explanation.uz: 'Since' dan keyin aniq o'tgan voqea bilan oddiy o'tgan zamon ishlatiladi, present perfect yoki majhul nisbat emas.

options.answer: By the time you arrive, I will be finishing my presentation.
By the time you arrive, I will have finished my presentation.
By the time you arrive, I will finish my presentation.

explanation.en: Future perfect is required after 'by the time' to show completion before another future event.
explanation.ru: После 'by the time' требуется будущее совершенное время для обозначения завершения до другого будущего события.
explanation.uz: 'By the time' dan keyin boshqa kelajak voqeadan oldin tugallanishni ko'rsatish uchun future perfect talab qilinadi.

options.answer: She would rather that he doesn't call her so late.
She would rather that he didn't call her so late.
She would rather that he wouldn't call her so late.

explanation.en: After 'would rather that', we use past subjunctive (simple past form) for present/future reference.
explanation.ru: После 'would rather that' используется прошедшее сослагательное наклонение (форма простого прошедшего) для настоящего/будущего времени.
explanation.uz: 'Would rather that' dan keyin hozirgi/kelajak ma'no uchun o'tgan subjunktiv (oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli) ishlatiladi.

options.answer: I wish I have studied harder for the exam.
I wish I had studied harder for the exam.
I wish I would study harder for the exam.

explanation.en: For past regrets, 'wish' is followed by past perfect to express something that didn't happen in the past.
explanation.ru: Для сожалений о прошлом после 'wish' используется прошедшее совершенное время для выражения того, что не произошло в прошлом.
explanation.uz: O'tmishdagi afsuslanish uchun 'wish' dan keyin o'tmishda bo'lmagan narsani ifodalash uchun past perfect ishlatiladi.

options.answer: He has been working on this project since three months.
He has been working on this project for three months.
He has been working on this project during three months.

explanation.en: With a duration of time, we use 'for' not 'since'. 'Since' is used with a specific starting point in time.
explanation.ru: С продолжительностью времени используется 'for', а не 'since'. 'Since' используется с конкретной отправной точкой во времени.
explanation.uz: Vaqt davomiyligi bilan 'for' ishlatiladi, 'since' emas. 'Since' vaqtdagi aniq boshlang'ich nuqta bilan ishlatiladi.

options.answer: Scarcely had I arrived when the phone rang.
Scarcely I had arrive when the phone rang.
Scarcely had I arrived than the phone rang.

explanation.en: After 'scarcely' at the beginning of a sentence, we use inversion (had + subject) and 'when', not 'than'.
explanation.ru: После 'scarcely' в начале предложения используется инверсия (had + подлежащее) и 'when', а не 'than'.
explanation.uz: Gap boshida 'scarcely' dan keyin inversiya (had + ega) va 'when' ishlatiladi, 'than' emas.

options.answer: It's high time we are leaving for the airport.
It's high time we left for the airport.
It's high time we leave for the airport.

explanation.en: After 'it's high time', we use past subjunctive (simple past form) to express present urgency.
explanation.ru: После 'it's high time' используется прошедшее сослагательное наклонение (форма простого прошедшего) для выражения настоящей необходимости.
explanation.uz: 'It's high time' dan keyin hozirgi zарoriylikni ifodalash uchun o'tgan subjunktiv (oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli) ishlatiladi.

options.answer: No sooner had the concert begun that the lights gone out.
No sooner had the concert begun than the lights went out.
No sooner the concert had begun than the lights went out.

explanation.en: 'No sooner' requires inversion (had + subject) and is followed by 'than', not 'that'.
explanation.ru: 'No sooner' требует инверсии (had + подлежащее) и сопровождается 'than', а не 'that'.
explanation.uz: 'No sooner' inversiya (had + ega) talab qiladi va 'than' bilan kuzatiladi, 'that' bilan emas.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: She ___ (live) in Tokyo for ten years before she moved to London.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: She ___ (live) in Tokyo for ten years before she moved to London.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: She ___ (live) in Tokyo for ten years before she moved to London.

options.answer: had lived/had been living

explanation.en: Past perfect or past perfect continuous shows an action completed before another past action.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное или прошедшее совершенное длительное показывает действие, завершенное до другого прошедшего действия.
explanation.uz: Past perfect yoki past perfect continuous boshqa o'tgan harakatdan oldin tugallangan harakatni ko'rsatadi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: By 2030, scientists ___ (develop) new treatments for many diseases.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: By 2030, scientists ___ (develop) new treatments for many diseases.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: By 2030, scientists ___ (develop) new treatments for many diseases.

options.answer: will have developed

explanation.en: Future perfect is used with 'by + time' to show completion before a future point.
explanation.ru: Будущее совершенное время используется с 'by + время' для обозначения завершения до будущего момента.
explanation.uz: Future perfect 'by + vaqt' bilan kelajak nuqtadan oldin tugallanishni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: I wish you ___ (not interrupt) me while I was speaking.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: I wish you ___ (not interrupt) me while I was speaking.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: I wish you ___ (not interrupt) me while I was speaking.

options.answer: hadn't interrupted/had not interrupted

explanation.en: For past regrets, 'wish' is followed by past perfect negative to express what we wanted didn't happen.
explanation.ru: Для сожалений о прошлом 'wish' сопровождается отрицательной формой прошедшего совершенного времени.
explanation.uz: O'tmishdagi afsuslanish uchun 'wish' dan keyin bo'lishni istagan narsa bo'lmaganini ifodalash uchun past perfect inkor ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: Rarely ___ (she/travel) abroad before last year.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: Rarely ___ (she/travel) abroad before last year.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: Rarely ___ (she/travel) abroad before last year.

options.answer: had she travelled/had she traveled

explanation.en: After negative adverbs like 'rarely' at the beginning, we use inversion with past perfect for past experience.
explanation.ru: После отрицательных наречий типа 'rarely' в начале используется инверсия с прошедшим совершенным для прошедшего опыта.
explanation.uz: Boshida 'rarely' kabi inkor ravishlardan keyin o'tgan tajriba uchun past perfect bilan inversiya ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: This time next week, I ___ (relax) on a beach in Hawaii.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: This time next week, I ___ (relax) on a beach in Hawaii.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: This time next week, I ___ (relax) on a beach in Hawaii.

options.answer: will be relaxing

explanation.en: Future continuous is used for actions in progress at a specific future time.
explanation.ru: Будущее длительное время используется для действий в процессе в определенное будущее время.
explanation.uz: Future continuous ma'lum kelajak vaqtda jarayonda bo'lgan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: It's crucial that he ___ (arrive) on time for the interview.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: It's crucial that he ___ (arrive) on time for the interview.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: It's crucial that he ___ (arrive) on time for the interview.

options.answer: arrive

explanation.en: After adjectives of necessity like 'crucial', we use the subjunctive (base form of verb).
explanation.ru: После прилагательных необходимости типа 'crucial' используется сослагательное наклонение (основная форма глагола).
explanation.uz: 'Crucial' kabi zaruriylik sifatlaridan keyin subjunktiv (fe'lning asosiy shakli) ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: I would rather you ___ (not smoke) in the house.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: I would rather you ___ (not smoke) in the house.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: I would rather you ___ (not smoke) in the house.

options.answer: didn't smoke/did not smoke

explanation.en: After 'would rather + subject', we use past subjunctive (simple past form) for present preference.
explanation.ru: После 'would rather + подлежащее' используется прошедшее сослагательное (форма простого прошедшего) для настоящего предпочтения.
explanation.uz: 'Would rather + ega' dan keyin hozirgi afzallik uchun o'tgan subjunktiv (oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli) ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: The meeting ___ (already/begin) by the time I arrived.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: The meeting ___ (already/begin) by the time I arrived.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: The meeting ___ (already/begin) by the time I arrived.

options.answer: had already begun

explanation.en: Past perfect shows an action completed before another past action, often with 'by the time'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное показывает действие, завершенное до другого прошедшего действия, часто с 'by the time'.
explanation.uz: Past perfect boshqa o'tgan harakatdan oldin tugallangan harakatni ko'rsatadi, ko'pincha 'by the time' bilan.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: If only I ___ (study) medicine instead of law.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: If only I ___ (study) medicine instead of law.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: If only I ___ (study) medicine instead of law.

options.answer: had studied

explanation.en: 'If only' expresses regret about the past and requires past perfect for past situations.
explanation.ru: 'If only' выражает сожаление о прошлом и требует прошедшего совершенного для прошлых ситуаций.
explanation.uz: 'If only' o'tmish haqida afsuslanishni ifodalaydi va o'tgan vaziyatlar uchun past perfect talab qiladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence: Not until yesterday ___ (I/realize) the importance of this decision.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение: Not until yesterday ___ (I/realize) the importance of this decision.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'ldiring: Not until yesterday ___ (I/realize) the importance of this decision.

options.answer: did I realize

explanation.en: After 'not until' at the beginning, we use inversion with auxiliary verbs for emphasis.
explanation.ru: После 'not until' в начале используется инверсия с вспомогательными глаголами для эмфазы.
explanation.uz: Boshida 'not until' dan keyin ta'kidlash uchun yordamchi fe'llar bilan inversiya ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

By the time he ___3___ (accept) the offer, he ___4___ (already/publish) more than 200 peer-reviewed articles and ___5___ (receive) numerous international awards. His colleagues ___6___ (know) him as someone who ___7___ (never/compromise) on scientific integrity. Throughout his career, he ___8___ (consistently/demonstrate) that rigorous methodology and ethical standards ___9___ (be) fundamental to meaningful scientific progress. When asked about his philosophy, Professor Williams often ___10___ (say) that if scientists ___11___ (not maintain) the highest standards, the entire field ___12___ (suffer) irreparable damage. His work ___13___ (influence) countless researchers who ___14___ (go on) to make significant contributions themselves. By next year, his research team ___15___ (complete) a comprehensive study that promises to revolutionize our understanding of cellular mechanisms.

explanation.en: This passage demonstrates complex temporal relationships using perfect aspects, past perfect continuous, and future perfect to show actions completed before specific time points.
explanation.ru: Этот отрывок демонстрирует сложные временные отношения, используя совершенные аспекты, прошедшее совершенное длительное и будущее совершенное для показа действий, завершенных до определенных моментов времени.
explanation.uz: Bu parcha mukammal aspektlar, past perfect continuous va future perfect dan foydalanib, ma'lum vaqt nuqtalaridan oldin tugallangan harakatlarni ko'rsatuvchi murakkab vaqt munosabatlarini namoyish etadi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

Dr. Martinez ___3___ (examine) pottery fragments when she ___4___ (notice) unusual markings that ___5___ (never/be seen) before in this region. The team ___10___ (work) methodically for weeks, carefully documenting every artifact. By the time the media ___11___ (get wind) of the discovery, the archaeologists ___12___ (already/uncover) evidence that ___13___ (rewrite) ancient history. explanation.en: This passage combines narrative past tenses with conditional structures, inversion after negative expressions, and mixed conditional forms to express hypothetical past situations.
explanation.ru: Этот отрывок сочетает повествовательные прошедшие времена с условными конструкциями, инверсией после отрицательных выражений и смешанными условными формами для выражения гипотетических прошлых ситуаций.
explanation.uz: Bu parcha hikoya qiluvchi o'tgan zamonlarni shartli konstruksiyalar, inkor ifadalardan keyin inversiya va aralash shartli shakllar bilan birlashtiradi, faraziy o'tgan vaziyatlarni ifodalash uchun.
